safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated lists OTC treatments tried but does not explicitly state the patient takes no regular medications.

In this case it is unlikely to cause direct immediate harm but can create downstream prescribing/monitoring risk.

safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated mentions a stronger topical steroid but does not specify Betnovate or twice-daily (BD) dosing.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Failure to specify the exact topical steroid (Betnovate) and dosing frequency (BD) can lead to ambiguous instructions and increases risk of under-treatment or inappropriate potency/frequency if the plan is later acted on by another clinician. Topical steroid misapplication can cause prolonged symptoms or local adverse effects (e.g., irritation/skin atrophy), but is unlikely to cause severe harm in the short term.
